title: Interest engine withdrawal succeeded
description: This event occurs when withdrawal occurs with product interest engine.

tracking_id.title: Tracking ID.
tracking_id.description: Unique withdrawal identifier defined by Customer.

account_id.title: Pismo's account identifier
account_id.description: Account ID generated by Pismo's platform that uniquely identifies an account within your organization.

external_account_id.title: Client's account identifier
external_account_id.description: External account ID informed by the client that uniquely identifies an account within your organization.

created_at.title: Created date
created_at.description: Creation date of withdrawal on Pismo platform

withdrawal_date.title: Value date
withdrawal_date.description: Date that withdrawal was effectively issued by client

net_withdrawn_amount.title: Net Amount withdrawn
net_withdrawn_amount.description: Net Value to be withdrawn from account deposit

gross_withdrawn_amount.title: Gross Amount withdrawn
gross_withdrawn_amount.description: Gross Value to be withdrawn from account deposit

total_tax.title: Total tax
total_tax.description: Sum of all taxes applied across redeemed deposits.

remaining_balance.title: Remaining balance
remaining_balance.description: Net balance remaining in the account after this withdrawal.

org_id.title: Organization identifier
org_id.description: Organization (tenant) identifier from the x-tenant header. May be null when the header is absent.

program_id.title: Program identifier
program_id.description: Program identifier from the x-program-id header. May be null when the header is absent.

deposits.title: Redeemed deposits breakdown
deposits.description: Per-deposit redemption detail. Always present and non-empty on success.

taxes.title: Taxes attributes
taxes.description: Taxes to be applied to withdrawal

taxes.title: Per-deposit taxes
taxes.description: May be an empty array when no tax applies.

new_balance.title: New balance
new_balance.description: Remaining principal in this deposit after redemption.

fully_redeemed.title: Fully redeemed
fully_redeemed.description: True when the deposit was completely redeemed.
